spark: Sesh swore to guard a ferryman's daughter on the river road, and slept drunk the night slavers took her

focal.name: Sesh Reedspear
focal.who: A lizardman spearman who never drinks.
focal.backstory: Sesh Reedspear was paid to see a ferryman's daughter safely down the river road to her new post. He drank himself to sleep at the last camp, and slavers took her before dawn.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
